name: pawangtools
description: PawangTools monorepo - membership portal & HWID license server

scripts.dev: concurrently --names "backend,frontend" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
